baseItems.name: 50A DC-DC battery charger with built-in MPPT solar charger
baseItems.whatItIs: Charges the house batteries from the van's alternator while you drive, at up to 50 amps.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A few hours on the road refills the batteries even on a cloudy day, without draining the van's own starting battery.

baseItems.name: 110V outlet with USB-A and USB-C
baseItems.whatItIs: Four 110-volt outlets with USB-A and USB-C ports, plus dedicated outlets for the induction cooktop and the microwave.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Charge phones and laptops where you actually use them, with no extension cords across the counter.

baseItems.name: 110V GFCI outlet
baseItems.whatItIs: A 110-volt outlet with ground fault protection, and a second one in the equipment compartment.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: It cuts the power in a fraction of a second if water and electricity meet, which matters in a van with a sink and a shower.

baseItems.name: 30A shore power inlet and 25' cord
baseItems.whatItIs: An outside plug for campground or driveway power, rated at 30 amps.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Plug in at a campsite or at home and the whole van runs on grid power while the batteries charge.

baseItems.name: LED strip ceiling lights with lens cover, two full-length runs, dimmable
baseItems.whatItIs: Two lens-covered LED strips running the length of the ceiling, recessed into the slats.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Even light from end to end with no fixtures to bump your head on.

baseItems.name: 200W rooftop solar
baseItems.whatItIs: Roof-mounted solar panels rated at 200 watts, sized to the roof on the shorter van.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Every sunny hour tops the batteries back up, so you can stay parked off-grid for days instead of hunting for a plug.

baseItems.name: 33-gallon fresh water tank over the wheel well
baseItems.whatItIs: A 33-gallon fresh water tank that sits over the wheel well, insulated with Havelock wool.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Enough water for several days of cooking, dishes and showers, kept inside the insulated van where it is protected from the cold.

baseItems.name: Fresh and grey tank level sensor
baseItems.whatItIs: A sensor that reads how full the fresh water tank is.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: You see how much water is left before you run dry, not after.

baseItems.name: 11-gallon grey water holding tank
baseItems.whatItIs: An 11-gallon tank that holds the water from the sink and shower until you can empty it.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: It keeps used water off the ground, which campgrounds and most public land require.

baseItems.name: Exterior fill port and drain valves
Water lines, fittings and winterizing valves (lot)
4-gallon electric water heater
baseItems.whatItIs: A 4-gallon electric tank water heater.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Hot water for dishes and a quick shower, heated by the battery system or shore power.

baseItems.name: Rear-door outdoor shower, hot and cold
baseItems.whatItIs: A shower head with hot and cold water at the rear doors.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Rinse off sand, mud or the dog before anyone climbs inside.

baseItems.name: Sound deadening on floor, walls and doors
Stainless sink with hot and cold faucet
Fold-down table out of the sliding door
baseItems.whatItIs: A table that folds down outside the sliding door.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: An outdoor counter for coffee, cooking or a laptop, right where the view is.

baseItems.name: Wood-style vinyl flooring
baseItems.whatItIs: Vinyl flooring with a wood grain look.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: It takes sand, snow and wet boots, cleans with a wipe and still looks warm.

baseItems.name: Cabinetry: CNC-cut, laminated, edge-banded Baltic birch ply
baseItems.whatItIs: Cabinets CNC cut from Baltic birch plywood, then laminated and edge banded in our shop.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Baltic birch is strong and light and holds a screw, which keeps cabinets tight on washboard roads.

baseItems.name: Overhead cabinet with LED strip underneath
baseItems.whatItIs: Three overhead cabinets, with LED strip lighting in recessed slots underneath.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Clothes, food and gear up high and off the floor, with light on the counter below.

baseItems.name: Overhead cabinet with LED strip underneath
baseItems.whatItIs: Five overhead cabinets, with LED strip lighting in recessed slots underneath.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Clothes, food and gear up high and off the floor, with light on the counter below.

baseItems.name: Under-counter double-door cabinet (20x36)
baseItems.whatItIs: A double-door cabinet under the counter, 20 by 36 inches.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Room for pots, pans and pantry food right where you cook.

baseItems.name: Under-counter drawer cabinet (20x15)
baseItems.whatItIs: A drawer cabinet under the counter, 20 by 15 inches.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Utensils and small things stay sorted instead of rattling around.

baseItems.name: Under-counter storage cabinet (20x15)
baseItems.whatItIs: A storage cabinet under the counter, 20 by 15 inches.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: More closed storage in the galley for the things you reach for every day.

baseItems.name: Floor-to-ceiling closet with shelves and hanging rod (12" wide)
baseItems.whatItIs: A 12-inch-wide closet with shelves and a hanging rod.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Jackets and good clothes hang up instead of living in a duffel.

baseItems.name: Rear garage storage under the bed
Queen memory foam mattress, 6" thick
baseItems.whatItIs: A queen-size memory foam mattress, 6 inches thick.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A real bed you do not make up every night, and a real night's sleep.

baseItems.name: Bench seat with storage inside
baseItems.whatItIs: A bench seat with storage inside.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Seating for meals, and a place to stow gear under the cushion.

baseItems.name: Swivel adjustable table
baseItems.whatItIs: An adjustable table on a Lagun mount that swivels and moves, with black hardware.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: It swings to the front seats or the bench, or out of the way.

baseItems.name: Sliding door T-vent window, passenger side
baseItems.whatItIs: A T-vent window in the passenger sliding door.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Fresh air and a view on the door side, even with the door shut.

baseItems.name: Privacy curtains for the cab and windows
Carbon monoxide and smoke detector
baseItems.whatItIs: A combined carbon monoxide and smoke alarm.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: It wakes you if there is smoke, or if a heater or engine problem puts carbon monoxide in the cabin.

baseItems.name: Fire extinguisher, mounted
baseItems.whatItIs: A mounted fire extinguisher.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Basic safety gear, mounted where you can reach it.

upgrades.name: 3000W pure sine wave inverter/charger, UL rated
upgrades.whatItIs: Turns battery power into 110-volt household power, up to 3,000 watts, and charges the batteries when you plug in. UL rated, pure sine wave.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: It runs the microwave, the induction cooktop and anything else with a normal plug, with clean power that is safe for laptops and cameras.

upgrades.name: Dry flush toilet with black cover, white
upgrades.whatItIs: A waterless toilet that seals each use in a leak-proof bag inside a replaceable cartridge. White, with a black cover.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: No black tank to dump and no smell, and it uses no water, so the fresh tank lasts longer.

upgrades.name: Premium insulation package, all Havelock wool
upgrades.whatItIs: Natural sheep's wool insulation throughout the van, with no foam on the water lines.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Wool keeps the van warmer in winter and cooler in summer, handles condensation well and cuts road noise.

upgrades.name: Deluxe roof vent fan with remote
upgrades.whatItIs: A roof fan that pulls stale air out or fresh air in, with a hood so it can run in the rain.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: It clears cooking smells and moisture, and on many nights it is all the cooling you need.

upgrades.name: Refrigerator with freezer
upgrades.whatItIs: A 12-volt refrigerator with a freezer section.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Keeps food cold for the whole trip on little battery power, so there is no ice to buy every day.

upgrades.name: In-counter double burner induction cooktop
upgrades.whatItIs: A two-burner induction cooktop set into the counter.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Fast, precise cooking on battery power, with no open flame and no propane.

upgrades.name: Wood veneer slat panel ceiling
upgrades.whatItIs: A wood veneer slat panel ceiling.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: It feels like a cabin, and the slats help soak up road noise.

upgrades.name: Full-size driver side T-vent window
upgrades.whatItIs: A full-size window on the driver side with a T-vent that opens.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Daylight, a view and a cross breeze with the roof fan.

upgrades.name: Solid glass rear door windows
upgrades.whatItIs: Solid glass windows in both rear cargo doors.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Light and a view out the back, including from the bed.

upgrades.name: Lithium house battery bank, 920Ah
upgrades.whatItIs: 920 amp-hours of lithium iron phosphate battery storage, the house power for everything in the van.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Enough stored power to run the fridge, lights, fans, cooktop and laptops for days, in a stable battery chemistry that lasts thousands of charges.

upgrades.name: 110V outlet with USB-A and USB-C, added
Cell signal booster
upgrades.whatItIs: An outside antenna and an amplifier that pull in a weak cell signal and repeat it inside the van.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: One bar outside becomes a usable signal inside, for calls, maps and working from the road.

upgrades.name: 24" smart TV with swivel mount and 110V outlet
Apple CarPlay and Android Auto head unit
200W rooftop solar, added (400W total)
upgrades.whatItIs: Roof-mounted solar panels rated at 400 watts, wired to charge the house batteries.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Every sunny hour tops the batteries back up, so you can stay parked off-grid for days instead of hunting for a plug.

upgrades.name: Indoor shower, not tiled, hot and cold
Tile the indoor shower
upgrades.whatItIs: A fully tiled shower inside the van, with hot and cold water.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: A dusty trail day ends clean, inside and out of the weather.

upgrades.name: 12V roof-mounted A/C with remote
upgrades.whatItIs: A roof-mounted air conditioner that runs on the 12-volt battery system.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Cool air on a hot afternoon without a generator or a campground hookup.

upgrades.name: Hydronic heat and hot water
upgrades.whatItIs: A hydronic heater that warms the cabin with heated fluid, burning the van's own fuel.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Dry, even heat on cold mornings, off-grid, with no propane tank on board.

upgrades.name: 700W microwave, black, with cabinet enclosure and outlet
upgrades.whatItIs: A 700-watt microwave in black, with its own outlet in the overhead cabinet.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Reheat dinner or a coffee in a minute, powered by the inverter.

upgrades.name: Pop-up end counter, black folding bracket
upgrades.whatItIs: A counter extension on a black folding bracket at the end of the galley.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Extra prep space when you need it, folded away when you need the aisle.

upgrades.name: Sink insert cutting board
upgrades.whatItIs: A cutting board that drops into the sink.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Covers the sink and turns it into more counter while you prep.

upgrades.name: Rectangular window with slider or T-vent
Safari roof rack with rooftop deck and side ladder
upgrades.whatItIs: A roof rack with a roof-top deck and a side ladder.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Carry boards, boxes or chairs up top, and climb up for the view or to clean the solar panels.

upgrades.name: Light bar on the roof rack, basic
Light bar on the roof rack
upgrades.whatItIs: An LED light bar mounted to the roof rack.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Lights up a campsite or a dark forest road well past the headlights.

upgrades.name: Rooftop tent with 300W solar on the tent (roof rack required)
50" forward light bar above the windshield
Front bumper with 12S winch, wireless remote and black D-rings
upgrades.whatItIs: A steel front bumper with a WARN 12S winch, a wireless remote and black D-rings.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Pull yourself, or someone else, out of sand or mud, and protect the front of the van on rough trails.

upgrades.name: Bumper-mounted lights, pair (bumper required)
upgrades.whatItIs: Two KC lights mounted on the front bumper.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Wide light close in, where the roof light bar does not reach.

upgrades.name: Body flares, paint matched
upgrades.whatItIs: Fender flares painted to match the van.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: They cover the wider all-terrain tires and keep rocks and mud off the paint.

upgrades.name: No-rub front fender kit
upgrades.whatItIs: A kit that gives the front fenders extra clearance.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: The bigger tires turn all the way without rubbing.

upgrades.name: Electric awning with LED light
upgrades.whatItIs: A power awning with a built-in LED light.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Shade and rain cover outside the sliding door at the push of a button, with light for the evening.

upgrades.name: Tire carrier
upgrades.whatItIs: A spare tire carrier on the rear of the van.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: The full-size spare rides where you can reach it, not under the van.

upgrades.name: B2 bike carrier with horizontal bars (trays not included)
upgrades.whatItIs: A rear carrier with horizontal bike bars. Bike trays are not included.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Bikes ride on the outside, not on your bed.

upgrades.name: Monster box, below the bike bars
upgrades.whatItIs: A storage box mounted on the rear, directly below the bike bars.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Outside storage for the muddy, wet or smelly gear you do not want inside.

upgrades.name: Power steps
upgrades.whatItIs: Electric running boards that drop down when a door opens and tuck away when it closes.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: An easy step into a lifted van, with nothing hanging low to catch on rocks when you drive.

upgrades.name: Four Peaks package: foldable jump seats and an extra bed
Necessities off-road package: side steps, perimeter lights, front light bar
Advanced off-road package: lift kit, rock sliders, bumper, spare tire carrier, lighting
Advanced exterior light package: light bar and perimeter lights
Wheels and tires package: 5 all-terrain wheels and tires
upgrades.whatItIs: Five all-terrain wheels and tires, spare included.
